claim_map.title: Regional Murex fixing gates
claim_map.text: For CN, SG, IN, and MY, the real-time VD-7 fixed leg with pending-fixing Y waits for another leg. Murex sends reversal and net amount after fixing; cancel the fixed leg and process the net cashflow. UK/DE batch VD-2 through VD-7 has the same Y hold. Real-time reversal/net replacements with X create Fixing Unknown; the correcting file supplies N. Process file corrections only for WAITING, Pending Exception, Pending Operator or Pending Verification, and Fixing Unknown. Do not reprocess an already-cancelled reversal. Batch N continues normal checking.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: UK/DE near-date and source-specific leg count
claim_map.text: For UK/DE real-time VD through VD-1, X blocks as Fixing Unknown. Correcting file Y moves to Pending Another Leg; N continues checks. Stella IRS-interest detection covers FixedFloat, OIS, FloatFloat, and FixedFixed with Coupon/Fixed or Coupon/Float, excluding Withdrawals. Compare RATAN and TDX counts for the same cashflow ID and value date; fewer RATAN cashflows waits for another leg. The Murex branch uses pending-fixing Y and excludes Withdrawals.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Aggregation and scenario limits
claim_map.text: The parent view proposes within-trade fixed/floating auto-netting and cross-trade aggregation. Refixing before release auto-un-nets and re-nets. Intermediate resultants die and components link to the final resultant. Some example arithmetic is inconsistent, including a fixed amount changing from 100 to 200 with a displayed 120 resultant. These are expected scenarios, without actual failure or test-pass evidence. Do not derive corrected accounting values from inconsistent examples.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Distinct resultant states and release boundaries
claim_map.text: The child within-trade example uses VERIFIED where the parent uses WAITING. No source establishes precedence. The settled-refixing example holds withdrawal and replacement in WAITING with Cancel / Amend after payment release, followed by manual netting. This does not replace NDS REVERSAL/REBOOK semantics. Manual netting with two CDS trades and a pending IRS fixed leg is a specific request, without a universal bypass. The final un-net section is explicitly NOT Required for Day 1.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: FMRP unequal schedule exception
claim_map.text: The different-value-date proposal applies only to FMRP, excluding Murex 2.11. Query TDSX by trade ID and inspect first- and second-leg periodicAdjustedInterestPaymentDate lists. A schedule with only one leg bypasses Pending Another Leg and continues checks. The wording about a date absent from either leg remains ambiguous. Serialized trade fixtures and images do not fill that gap.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: NDS scope and scheduler
claim_map.text: RATAN must net NDS by NID while Murex stops NDS netting. Product scope names NDS, NDS Fixing, NDIRS, NDCF, NDFRA, ND CDS Fixing, ND CDS, and ND-Convert. Group by booking entity, counterparty, value date, currency, and NID. Scan every 30 minutes for today through two business days ahead, WAITING with Pending Exception containing Pending NDS Netting. That NSTP rule must be live. Group Blotter must permit normal progression into eligibility.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: NDIRS exception and parent dependency
claim_map.text: NDIRS USD fixing settles in deliverable currency and is STP without this netting. Other scoped components, including ND CCS, are NSTP. Confirmation match must follow the Murex logic, whose full contract is not reproduced. Query parent typology from TDS3 using the NID-linked parent trade; take the final pipe-delimited source-instrument-type value. Arrival order can leave that value empty; handling remains unresolved.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: NDS amendment and resultant rules
claim_map.text: Before release, amendment or refixing auto-un-nets and re-nets reversal/new next cycle. Cancellation cancels the original and leaves the remaining component waiting if no partner arrives. After release, reversal/new require NSTP REVERSAL and REBOOK manual handling. System and manual un-net are prohibited after payment release. Before release, manually netting the resultant with other products is proposed. The resultant uses N plus 11 digits, UUID message/netting IDs, QUEUED, Unaffirmed, GROSS, CASH, TOBESENT, and zero versions. Common family/group/type/typology/strategy/trade/taxonomy values inherit only when equal, else blank. CFI comes from the non-NDS-Fixing component; other attributes use the first component. Payment_Type appears both blank and NDS Fixing Netting; ordering and precedence remain unresolved.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

owner_questions.question: Which IRS source variant is authoritative for each scope?
owner_questions.investigation: Parent and child are distinct snapshots. They differ in examples and resultant states; neither establishes supersession.
owner_questions.consequence: Cannot treat them as aliases or a unified effective rule.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Should an IRS auto-net resultant be WAITING or VERIFIED, and which checks permit that state?
owner_questions.investigation: Parent example uses WAITING; child uses VERIFIED. Post-settlement examples separately retain WAITING exceptions.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Does expected count use cashflow ID/value date or schedule date/currency?
owner_questions.investigation: Selected IRS views retain ID/date counting plus a separate FMRP schedule-date exception. Missing-leg wording is ambiguous.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Which file ordering, retry, and late-arrival policies govern fixing flags?
owner_questions.investigation: UK/DE X/Y/N branches and eligible waiting exceptions are explicit; recovery and duplicate policies are incomplete.
owner_questions.consequence: No delivery reliability contract follows from the examples.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Which calendar and time zone define the NDS three-business-date scan?
owner_questions.investigation: NDS says today through today plus two business days without naming calendar or zone.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: What wait, retry, or exception rule applies when TDS3 parent typology is absent?
owner_questions.investigation: NDS acknowledges arrival ordering can return empty parent typology. No fallback is supplied.
owner_questions.consequence: Cannot default an unknown parent to an approved STP/NSTP classification.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Which NDS Payment_Type row takes precedence: blank or NDS Fixing Netting?
owner_questions.investigation: The same resultant mapping table specifies both values.
owner_questions.consequence: Cannot produce a unique resultant schema.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.
